== Improved page source reliability during Android screen transitions

Appium page source requests on Android devices no longer intermittently fail while an app screen opens or closes.

Previously, finding an element by XPath immediately after opening a screen or pressing *Back* could return `SessionException: Agent error: GET /system/inventory, node_access_error ()`.

When the app window is briefly unavailable during a screen transition, page source requests now retry for up to 1 second before returning an error. The improvement also applies to the view hierarchy that manual sessions capture after each action.

On screens that display only system windows, such as the lock screen or an expanded notification shade, page source requests still return `node_access_error` after about 1 second.
